svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two brackets, one above the other, each an arm and a stub:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: arm 117.5 long along the rail line, stub 30.5 long out to the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: head tube; lower bracket centred 745 up, upper 805 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld each stub square to the end of its arm (an L), then cope

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the stub's free end to the 44 mm head tube.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Jig the head tube upright 385 out from the centre line and 60

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: behind the rear axle line, its bottom 730 above the ground.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld both stubs to the head tube, then both arm ends to the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rear face of the hip sleeve (left and right are mirror images).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pin guide: 14 mm tube 57 long welded upright on the upper stub,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 45 in from the head tube axis; drill the stub top 9 mm under it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Face both head tube ends square and ream the bore to the headset

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: maker's size (34 mm for external cups).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: head tube upright both ways within 0.5 degree.
